title: geoBoundaries CGAZ Global Administrative Boundaries
description: Every administrative boundary in geoBoundaries' Comprehensive Global Administrative Zones (CGAZ) composite, mirrored as cloud-native GeoParquet and PMTiles. Three boundary collections cover the globe seamlessly: 218 country-level units, 3,224 first-level units and 49,349 second-level units, built by [William & Mary geoLab](https://geolab.wm.edu/) from country submissions clipped to US Department of State international boundaries, with disputed areas carried as polygons of their own. A fourth collection is a name search index, one row per named unit across all three levels, sorted so that a client can resolve a typed prefix with range requests instead of a download. This is a mirror; [geoBoundaries](https://www.geoboundaries.org/) is the authoritative source. Read the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) before you query it.
